basic_info.description: Experience the very best of North Beach living in this expansive full-floor, top-level condo offering an abundance of elegant living space with breathtaking outlooks and timeless character.  Featuring 2 bedrooms plus an office/bonus room this home is ideally suited for today's flexible lifestyle. Gorgeous original details pair beautifully with brilliant natural light throughout. The south-facing living room and large second bedroom showcase classic palladium casement bay windows framing Coit Tower and the Russian / Nob Hill skyline creating quintessential San Francisco views. A formal dining room flows seamlessly into the living room and is perfect for entertaining easily accommodating large gatherings of 12 or more. For day-to-day meals and gatherings, the spacious working kitchen opens to a large casual dining room with a bank of five windows and private balcony. Tucked quietly away at the rear of the home a generous primary suite, features large bay windows, walk-in closet, and ensuite bath for added privacy. Additional attributes include tons of closet space, an oversized laundry room with ample storage & counter space, EV compatible parking with interior access and lush shared garden w/ mature fruit trees. 98 Walkscore - minutes to Washington Sq, SF Bay & 1 blk to TJ's.
